incumbent.note: development diagnostic; not a holdout or clinical figure

revision_history.note: four single-factor variants; trigger on v2 <= incumbent
a4 accepted 345/345 at typed EM 0.2522: F4 controls acceptance, not accuracy; single-factor a2/a3 keep F4 and cannot isolate their factor on real data, so a24 and a34 are declared on top of a4

rules: Each triggered variant is a separately frozen contract; none runs by default.
Whole-v2 gains are never attributed to a single factor without the matching variant run.
Variant selection happens on validation only; no variant may be added after holdout exposure.
Two-factor variants keep a4's quote-optional parsing so that response acceptance is comparable across variants; each still removes exactly one further factor relative to a4.
Revision 1.1.0 was declared on validation evidence only, before any secondary-holdout exposure.
